name: container
description: A styled box that holds other blocks (builder library, 2026-11): card, lavender panel, gradient band, navy band, glass, outline, soft wash or plain, with width, padding, corner, background image and decoration options. The component draws the box; the block adapter puts its inner blocks where the box's <!--ap-slot--> marker is.

look.description: The look: white card, soft lavender panel, indigo-to-teal gradient band, deep navy band, frosted glass, outline, the blog header's soft colour wash, or no box at all.

width.description: Width: 800px (article), 1120px, 1280px, or the full page width.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL (covers the box).

overlay.description: Wash over the background image so text stays readable.

decoration.description: Background decoration: soft indigo and teal orbs, one large glow, a dot grid, or the panda peeking from the corner.
